pr_context.title: Fix critical vulnerability CVE-2017-5645 in log4j-core (test module)
pr_context.body: Upgrade org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core and org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-api from version 2.6.1 to 2.17.1 to remediate CVE-2017-5645 (Deserialization of Untrusted Data). Advisory: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-5645 GHSA: GHSA-fxph-q3j8-mv87

analysis_scope: Documentation updates to reflect log4j 2.6.1 -> 2.17.1 upgrade in test module

changes.issue: Test module (shoptester) is completely absent from all dependency tables. The table has columns for shop, stock, instruments, products, conductors, annotator but NOT test.
changes.action: Add 'test' column to all three dependency tables (Framework, Runtime, Test). In the Runtime table, add a checkmark for Log4j 2.17.1 in the test column.

changes.issue: Log4j 2.6.1 is listed as Outdated. After this PR, Log4j 2.17.1 in test module should be listed as Current/Acceptable. The Log4j 2.6.1 in shop remains outdated.
changes.action: Update the Outdated row to clarify 'Log4j 2.6.1 (shop module only)' and add 'Log4j 2.17.1 (test module)' to Current/Acceptable examples.

changes.issue: Only references shop/pom.xml. The test module previously had the same vulnerability (log4j 2.6.1) which is now remediated.
changes.action: Update to clarify this vulnerability now only affects the shop module. Add a note that the test module previously had log4j 2.6.1 but was remediated to 2.17.1 via PR #34.

changes.issue: No 'test' module section exists. The test module has log4j-api 2.17.1, log4j-core 2.17.1, and commons-httpclient 3.1.
changes.action: Add a new '### test' section with a dependency table listing the 3 dependencies.

changes.issue: No section for the test module. The test module's log4j has been upgraded from 2.6.1 to 2.17.1.
changes.action: Add a new '### 8. test Module (Recently Remediated)' section noting the log4j upgrade and the remaining commons-httpclient 3.1 which is outdated.

changes.issue: Log4j row says 'shop' module with version 2.6.1. Does not mention that the test module previously had the same issue, now remediated.
changes.action: Update Log4j row to clarify 'shop (only — test module remediated to 2.17.1)' and update the Impact Assessment.

changes.issue: States 'shop module' only. Does not mention the test module's previous vulnerability or its remediation.
changes.action: Update to clarify 'shop module (only — test module remediated to 2.17.1 via PR #34)'. Also update the Executive Summary and AWS Transformation Recommendation sections.

changes.issue: Only references the shop module. The test module had the same issue but has been fixed by this PR.
changes.action: Add a note under Priority 1.1 that the test module's log4j has already been remediated from 2.6.1 to 2.17.1. The remaining action is for the shop module only.

changes.issue: Says 'Log4j 2.6.1 vulnerability (CVE-2021-44228 / Log4Shell)' without module qualification. Now only the shop module is affected.
changes.action: Update to 'Log4j 2.6.1 vulnerability in shop module (CVE-2021-44228 / Log4Shell) — test module remediated to 2.17.1'

additional_observation.note: The test module row shows 'Spring Boot: N/A, Java: —'. This is accurate since the test module does not use Spring Boot. No changes needed for this PR.
